signals.name: Rabi wheat cash (Punjab-Haryana)
signals.items: tractors, two-wheelers, gold, phones, coolers and ACs
signals.reason: Wheat MSP payments reach farmers by direct transfer in Apr-May (procurement from 1-10 Apr)

signals.name: Rabi harvest cash (MP, UP, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Bihar)
signals.reason: Wheat, mustard and gram sales Mar-May overlap the summer wedding season (estimate)

signals.name: Kharif paddy cash (Punjab-Haryana)
signals.reason: Paddy procurement opens 1 Oct with MSP payments, so cash lands just before Diwali

signals.name: Kharif harvest cash (UP, Bihar, Odisha, WB, CG)
signals.reason: Paddy, soy and maize sales Oct-Dec feed festive and wedding buying (estimate)

signals.name: Kharif paddy cash (AP, Telangana, Karnataka)
signals.reason: Paddy sales Nov-Jan arrive ahead of Sankranti and the Magha wedding season (estimate)

signals.name: Cotton sale cash
signals.reason: CCI MSP buying Oct-Mar; 2025-26: Telangana 31.7 lakh bales, Maharashtra 27.2 lakh, Gujarat 20 lakh

signals.name: Sugarcane payments
signals.reason: Mills pay FRP with a lag through the Nov-Apr crushing season (often delayed)

signals.name: Coffee & pepper harvest cash
signals.reason: Coffee picked Dec-Feb and pepper Jan-Mar; planter cash peaks in Q1 (estimate)

signals.name: Tea-garden Puja bonus
signals.items: clothes, footwear, budget phones, puja items
signals.reason: Up to 20% Puja bonus paid by ~20 Sep for workers' Puja purchases

signals.name: Gulf remittances before Onam
signals.items: gold, kasavu sarees, TVs, fridges, cars
signals.reason: Remittances rise sharply ~15 days before Onam and go into jewellery, clothes and cars

signals.name: Gulf remittances before Eid
signals.items: Eid clothes, attar, gold, dates, gifts
signals.reason: NRI money flows home before Eid; Ramadan ~8 Feb-10 Mar 2027 (estimate)

signals.name: Punjab NRI winter visits
signals.items: wedding wear, gold, SUVs, home renovation
signals.reason: Diaspora visits from Canada, UK and US cluster weddings and big-ticket buys in winter (estimate)

signals.name: Diwali bonus (Gujarat-Maharashtra industry)
signals.items: gold, two-wheelers, TVs, phones, holiday travel
signals.reason: Surat diamond and textile units pay Diwali bonuses, then shut 2-4 weeks while workers travel home

signals.name: Durga Puja bonus
signals.reason: Puja bonus and ex-gratia from government, PSUs and industry fund new clothes before Pujo (estimate)

signals.name: Salary-day spike (first week)
signals.items: monthly grocery stock-up, fashion, beauty, small gadgets
signals.reason: Salaried urban buyers spend most in days 1-7 of each month; platforms run payday sales (estimate)

signals.name: Appraisal & hike season (IT hubs)
signals.reason: Traditional Apr-Jun hike cycle (TCS; Infosys letters in June); some firms moving to Sep-Oct

signals.name: Tax-saving squeeze
signals.reason: Salaried buyers park cash in tax-saving instruments and TDS peaks in Q4 (weaker under new regime; estimate)

signals.name: North India winter weddings
signals.items: lehengas, sherwanis, gold, gifts, appliances, furniture
signals.reason: CAIT: 46 lakh weddings and Rs 6.5 lakh cr spend in 1 Nov-14 Dec 2025; starts after Dev Uthani (~20 Nov 2026)

signals.name: North India late-winter weddings
signals.reason: Weddings resume after Makar Sankranti through Basant Panchami-Phalgun, pausing for Holashtak (estimate)

signals.name: Summer 'sahalag' weddings (North & Central)
signals.items: wedding wear, gold, coolers and ACs as gifts, furniture
signals.reason: Weddings cluster from Akshaya Tritiya to Devshayani Ekadashi (July), overlapping rabi cash (estimate)

signals.name: Tamil Thai-month weddings
signals.reason: Thai (mid-Jan to mid-Feb) is the peak wedding month after Margazhi, funded by the harvest

signals.name: South summer weddings
signals.reason: Chithirai-Vaikasi (TN) and Vaisakha-Jyeshtha (Telugu/Kannada) are big muhurtham months before Ashada/Aadi (estimate)

signals.name: Telugu-Kannada Magha & Karthika weddings
signals.reason: Karthika (Nov) and Magha-Phalguna (Feb-Mar) carry dense muhurthams (estimate)

signals.name: Bengal wedding season
signals.items: Banarasi sarees, gold, cosmetics, gifts, sweets
signals.reason: Agrahayan (mid-Nov to mid-Dec), Magh and Falgun are the Bengali wedding months

signals.name: Kerala Chingam & Medam weddings
signals.items: gold, kasavu and silk sarees, gifts
signals.reason: Chingam (Aug-Sep) and Medam (Apr-May) are peak; Karkidakam (Jul-Aug) is avoided (estimate)

signals.name: Muslim wedding season
signals.reason: Weddings avoid Ramadan and Muharram, clustering after Eid and in winter; dates shift ~11 days a year (estimate)

signals.name: Pitru Paksha (Shraddh)
signals.items: cars, two-wheelers, gold, new home goods
signals.reason: FADA: the 15-day Shraddh period routinely weakens September vehicle sales; gold demand is muted

signals.name: Kharmas (Dec-Jan)
signals.items: wedding buys, gold, vehicles, housewarming goods
signals.reason: Sun in Sagittarius (~15 Dec-14 Jan): weddings, housewarmings and new starts are avoided

signals.name: Kharmas (Mar-Apr)
signals.reason: Second Kharmas (Sun in Pisces, ~14 Mar-13 Apr) halts weddings until Baisakhi

signals.name: Holashtak
signals.reason: The 8 days before Holika Dahan (~16-23 Mar 2027) are avoided for weddings and new vehicles

signals.name: Chaturmas (no weddings)
signals.reason: Devshayani (25 Jul 2026) to Dev Uthani (~20 Nov 2026): Hindu weddings are scheduled outside this window

signals.name: Ashada (no new beginnings)
signals.reason: Ashada (~mid-Jun to mid-Jul) is avoided for weddings and new beginnings in Kannada and Telugu homes

signals.name: Ashada discount sales
signals.items: silk sarees, ethnic wear, appliances on offer
signals.reason: Hyderabad and Bengaluru stores run Ashadam sales of up to 50-66% off sarees and clothing

signals.name: Aadi (no new beginnings)
signals.reason: Aadi (mid-Jul to mid-Aug) is avoided for marriages, new ventures and moving house

signals.name: Aadi discount sales
signals.items: silk sarees, gold schemes, TVs, appliances
signals.reason: Aadi Thallupadi draws T Nagar crowds; jewellers run gold schemes and Flipkart runs an Aadi Sale

signals.name: Karkidakam
signals.reason: Karkidakam (mid-Jul to mid-Aug) is the monsoon/Ramayana month; weddings move to Chingam (estimate)

signals.name: Shravan: less non-veg
signals.items: meat, eggs and non-veg food orders
signals.reason: Many devotees avoid non-veg in Shravan; food delivery shifts to veg (estimate)

signals.name: Shravan fasting foods & puja
signals.items: farsan, wafers, sabudana, fasting snacks, puja items
signals.reason: Shravan fasting lifts farali and namkeen sales (Gujarat makers report up to 50% higher)

signals.name: Ramadan iftar & Eid shopping (2027)
signals.items: dates, dry fruits, iftar foods, Eid kurtas, attar, footwear
signals.reason: Ramadan ~8 Feb-10 Mar 2027, Eid ~10-11 Mar (estimate): food stock-up, then a big Eid apparel spike

signals.name: Ramadan pause on weddings
signals.reason: Muslim weddings pause in the fasting month and resume after Eid (estimate)
